notes.title: Patch 2.0 Hotfix
notes.content:
A micro patch has just been issued, aimed to fix some errors with Connect and Maze tabs that wrongfully interacted with each other.

There were some reports of a bug happening for the Hold tab but the data isn't still enough.

If you encounter a bug or an unintended behaviour please report it in the "Bug Report" section of the game's discussions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39640123/72271f901a0ca873c19df831b2d5d1cabb7f4f61.png[/img]

notes.title: Anniversary Patch: 2.0
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for you commitment!

It's been e fantastic experience and I've prepared a nice surprise for you!

The today's patch will turn the game into [b]Free to Play[/b] so everyone can test it out!

Here's some of the most important stuff:
[list]
[*] 3 New Gamemodes Added
[*] 3 New Leaderboards Added
[*] 8 New Achievements Added
[*] Revamped Menu UI
[*] Several Balance Changes addressed
[*] Several Bugfixes addressed
[/list]
Other than this, a [b]new DLC is available[/b], it is cosmetic only and will be issued for free to everyone who previously bought the game (keep in mind this process could not be instantaneous so please be patient). It will be on a brief sale and will include the [i]Rainbow Mode[/i] and [i]a Cool Party Hat[/i] for the assistant.

[b]Thank you again for all the support and good luck trying to climb the ladders![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39640123/729e2963686b10c5cf2867cfb489687d552dcc30.png[/img]

notes.title: Upcoming Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Dear players,
at the end of this month there will be a big content update for STAY's Anniversary.

The game will become [i]free to play [/i] and receive new achievements, gamemodes, leaderboards, tweaks and bugfixes!  

A cosmetic-only paid DLC (Supporter Pack) will be released and issued for free to everyone who previously bought the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39640123/f7e050923de043a63d7ce93e40184c157122895c.gif[/img]
